run_interactive_drqa_pipeline: run the DrQA interactive pipeline with a reader model, retriever model, and document database
process_question_with_drqa: process a question through the DrQA pipeline and print top predictions with highlighted context
run_drqa_with_candidate_file: run the DrQA pipeline restricted to a list of candidate answers from a file
run_drqa_on_gpu: run the DrQA interactive pipeline on a specified GPU device with CUDA enabled
usage_drqa_interactive: print the usage banner for the interactive DrQA pipeline interface
